title: 🛫 MSFS 2020 Bari Karol Wojtyła Airport Addon Review - A Must-Have! 🌟
description:
Discover the stunning new Bari Karol Wojtyła Airport addon for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020! In this review, we dive into the incredible features of this addon, including high-resolution textures, custom 3D models, dynamic lighting, and more. Whether you’re a seasoned pilot or a flight sim enthusiast, this addon is sure to enhance your virtual flying experience. Watch now to see why this is a must-have for your MSFS 2020 collection!

Bari Karol Wojtyła Airport (Italian: Aeroporto di Bari-Karol Wojtyła) is an airport serving the city of Bari in Italy. It is approximately 8 km (5 mi) northwest from the town centre. Named after Pope John Paul II, who was born Karol Wojtyła, the airport is also known as Palese Airport (Italian: Aeroporto di Palese) after a nearby neighbourhood. The airport handled 6,461,179 passengers in 2023.
